The Data Center New Build Deployment Enablement Manager (DEM) serves as the central coordination point for network infrastructure deployment at new data center builds - from cable start through Production Ready (PR). network build.
The DEM heavily influences cross-functional teams to provide and commit to dates, serves as the single source of truth for deployment milestones, and drives accountability when timelines slip. Milestone Coordination & Tracking
● Own and maintain the New Build Deployment Tracker for assigned buildings - tracking

In the late 1960s, Bell Labs was grappling with a large project: an unwieldy operating system called Multics. It was too complex, too slow, and ultimately Bell withdrew. A small group of researchers, led by Ken Thompson and Dennis Ritchie, decided to start over-not with grand designs, but with simplicity at the core.
They aimed for function over perfection and were deliberate in their collaboration. Engineers shared ideas as rough drafts, circulated them early, and refined them through iteration.
From this came Unix. It wasn't about working harder or sacrificing more - it was about getting ideas out quickly and leveraging collective intelligence early in the process.
This is central to how we build at Co-Star : we start with simple solutions, share them early as written docs, and evolve them through real-world feedback.
At Co-Star you’ll help tens of millions of people connect with each other and themselves-through astrology-in real, meaningful ways. We’re looking for a backend engineer who values feedback, who is both fast and deliberate, and who creates systems that let small teams deliver outsized results.

• Own delivery and move quickly. We’re looking for someone who eagerly seeks feedback and actively moves the ball forward - who genuinely enjoys getting their code into the world.

What you'll bring

• A sense of ownership over work end-to-end, accountability for results, and supportiveness for your team.

• Strong technical judgment. You can articulate tradeoffs clearly, especially when working with incomplete information or in pre-decision situations.

• You make informed decisions that balance speed with quality and see around corners to anticipate potential challenges.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and databases (we use PostgreSQL).
